svg.font-family: Segoe UI, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Every route of the Angular app, what the page shows and where it leads. Page colours match the feature library that implements it.
Before the navbar: "Skip to main content" (first Tab). Footer on every page: everise logo → /
Account menu: Your profile /profile/:username · Settings /settings · Sign out → /login
SIGNED IN ONLY — AuthGuard sends signed-out visitors to /login
• Tabs: Global Feed · Your Feed (signed in: followed authors)
• Popular tags sidebar: pick a tag to filter (tag tab)
• Previews with favorite ♥ and a pager
• Roulette results as duty cards, with the comment
or Tataru's remark for a guest's result
• Live: new posts pushed over a WebSocket appear at the top
• Offline: cached feed, favorites synced when back online
• Three reels: duty type, duty, party settings
• Duty Finder Settings: duty types, level range
• Per-type lists to pick duties one by one
• Commence spins; "Pause animations" stops the idle reels
• "Duty Found" window: the result, its wiki guide
Commence posts it to the feeds
signed in: with an optional comment
guest: Tataru posts it for them
• Game data (duties, roulettes, jobs, images) comes
from the backend, which caches it from XIVAPI
• A roulette result's duty card, then the comment
• Body rendered from Markdown, tag list
• Wrong details: the message, email kept
• A problem: the message, name and email kept
• Edit yours at /editor/:slug (a resolver loads it)
• Profile picture: choose, crop to a square, upload
• Dark mode toggle (saved in this browser)
• Avatar, bio; Follow (others) or Edit settings (you)
Lists come from feature-articles-list (shared with Home)

text.tspan: ; signed-out visitors of a guarded page go to
· form errors shown on the form
cookie set by the backend on sign in / sign up, sent with every API call (withCredentials).
API GETs are cached and replayed offline; favorites made offline are queued and synced later.
Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA): every page has its own title and one
; a page change moves the focus to it; dialogs keep the focus inside.
Pages are lazy-loaded per route; the URL of a deep link (e.g.
) is served the app shell by Cloudflare (SPA fallback).
